Repaired by specifying dimensionless coordinates and jets at a fixed positive reference mass, the full complex-linear spaces, and dimensionful coefficients mu_*^(4-Delta). Vacuum subtraction makes action changes finite on compact backgrounds. No power-counting restriction or loss of the full quotient is introduced.

The assigned current supplier Definition already states explicitly that C4=lambda B wedge K3(A) is admitted for real dimensionless lambda; its full counterterm-space declaration also includes this background polynomial. Thus admissibility follows from the cited F1, not locality alone. Graded cyclicity gives dK3=tr(F_A^2), and the product rule and compact support give the displayed variation. The full BRST shift is a coboundary of that admitted counterterm. The units repair preserves its admissibility and coefficient. The example carrier is unchanged.

No chirality sign, global extension or nonzero-class inference is used. Exact supplier quote in its owning contract was refreshed; the item guard is unchanged.
